title.en: Every item, right next to your inventory
title.zh-CN: 所有物品，就在背包旁边

caption.en: The item list sits on the right of every container screen, your bookmarks on the left.
caption.zh-CN: 物品列表在每个容器界面的右侧，书签在左侧。

title.en: One click fills the crafting grid

caption.en: Open a recipe, press +, and the ingredients jump from your inventory into the crafting table.
caption.zh-CN: 打开配方，点一下 +，材料就从背包放进工作台。

caption.en: Narrow the list down with words, exclusions like -ore, or tags like #logs.
caption.zh-CN: 用关键词、-ore 这样的排除词或 #logs 这样的标签筛选列表。

title.en: How to make it: press R

caption.en: Every way to get an item, with a tab for each workstation: crafting, smelting, blasting and more.
caption.zh-CN: 列出获得一个物品的所有方法，每种工作台一个标签页：合成、熔炼、高炉等等。

title.en: What is it for: press U

caption.en: All the recipes that use an item, here the 13 pages that need iron ingots.
caption.zh-CN: 列出用到某个物品的所有配方，比如这里用到铁锭的 13 页。

title.en: Bookmarks for the items you keep looking up

caption.en: Press A over any item to pin it to the list on the left.
caption.zh-CN: 鼠标指向任意物品按 A，就能把它固定到左侧列表。

caption.en: With cheats on, Ctrl-click the settings button and click any item to take a stack.
caption.zh-CN: 开启作弊后，按住 Ctrl 点设置按钮，再点物品就能直接拿一组。

title.zh-CN: 酿造、锻造、切石，应有尽有

caption.en: Press U on a workstation to see everything it can make, like all 102 brewing recipes.
caption.zh-CN: 对着工作台按 U，查看它能做的全部东西，比如全部 102 个酿造配方。

caption.en: The button next to the search bar opens the options: bookmarks, tooltips, search bar position and more.
caption.zh-CN: 搜索栏旁的按钮打开选项：书签、提示信息、搜索栏位置等。
